items.content:
Reading about how things get kept.

It started as the canon question and it hasn't stayed there — it's the
Alexandria thing, and the nitrate thing, and the Ethiopian thing, and it
is obviously also the acquisitions budget, which I did not notice for
about six months.

The pattern: nothing survives because it was best. It survives because
somebody could afford to keep copying it, and thought it was worth the
trouble, and wasn't interrupted.

summary: Naming the through-line: nothing survives because it was best
title: what I've actually been doing for ten months
